command: node --test (234 tests); awr takeover --reviewer <script returning a ledger whose new work item has no priority or required> on a throwaway project, then awr work show

checks.name: The reviewer prompt says to set priority and required only when the material states them
checks.details: The review prompt in lib/takeover-host.js has the rule 'Set priority and required on a work item only when the material states them. Otherwise leave both out; AWR accepts an item without them, and the owner sets them later.' test/takeover-host.test.js pins it by matching the rule's wording in the built prompt. The full suite passes: 234 tests, 0 failures. Limit: the prompt change was not re-run with a real model, so whether the model now leaves the fields out is unverified.
criteria: The reviewer prompt tells the reviewer to set priority and required on a work item only when the material states them, and a test pins that rule.

checks.name: AWR accepts a reviewed ledger whose new work items carry neither field
checks.details: With a real awr (the lab build of the takeover branch) a takeover on a throwaway project with a reviewer that returned a ledger whose only new work item W-EXPORT had id, title, status planned, goal and acceptance but no priority and no required completed (state needs_organization); awr work show W-EXPORT reported status planned, ready true, priority null, required null, and awr status counted it as planned. Limit: one work item shape on one throwaway project.
criteria: AWR accepts a reviewed ledger whose new work items carry neither field, checked with a real awr.
